Action 181 T-AXU-059 哑铃锤式弯举 / HAMMER CURL. Show the mid-to-upper phase of a slow simultaneous two-arm neutral-grip dumbbell hammer curl, not a supinated biceps curl. Woman standing steadily in a comfortable small staggered stance, both feet entirely planted, hips and torso upright with no swinging or lumbar arch. Slightly oblique side view facing right so both elbows, hands and weights are separately visible. Both upper arms vertical and close to the sides of ribs, elbows kept by her waist, shoulders relaxed down. Both elbows flexed about 90–105 degrees, forearms point forward/slightly upward. Her PALMS face INWARD toward each other and body midline, THUMBS upward, wrists straight and aligned with forearms. Each hand securely grips one small light unbranded gray dumbbell in NEUTRAL handshake grip. The long shafts of both dumbbells are VERTICAL with one end above and one end below each fist, not horizontal supinated grip. Keep both weights distinct and away from her body. Calm expression as reference.
Composition: one woman, one coherent exercise phase, one independent portrait photo 1122x1402 matching the 4:5 reference ratio; full head, both complete hands/weights and both feet within clean comfortable margins, normal lens perspective with no wide-angle distortion. Only the two needed lightweight dumbbells are present. No letters, caption, title, numbers, logos, watermark, arrows, inset, panels, collage, ghosted movement, other people, extra fingers or extra limbs.
